title: Jev review benchmark: the same labelled PRs reviewed with and without Jev, measured for recall, precision, cost and time

AC1.note: bench/jev-review/build-dataset.ts builds dataset.json deterministically from .metaproject/reviews/* and .metaproject/flows/*/reviews/* (public data only); label mapping documented in types.ts/README.md; 7 passing tests in build-dataset.test.ts on fixture flows. Real run: 254 packages, 1638 findings, 104 owning flows, committed as bench/jev-review/dataset.json.

AC2.note: bench/jev-review/adapters/{ci-triage,review-conform,not-available,registry}.ts: common ComponentAdapter interface (types.ts), without-jev/with-jev arms. ci-triage shells to keryx review ci-triage --eval (existing --eval set); review-conform shells to keryx review conform on PR metadata. flow-check-ac/review-jev-rules/severity-calibration are not-available stubs, no code dependency on flows 328/330/later. 9 passing adapter tests. Placed under bench/jev-review/ rather than scripts/ to stay coherent with AC1/AC6's bench/jev-review/ location for the dataset and results; both are explicitly-allowed alternatives per the frozen AC text.

AC3.note: metrics.ts computes accuracy (closed-world) and precision/noise (open-world flagging) with Wilson 95% CIs (reused from src/metrics/benchmark.ts deriveRate/wilsonInterval, this repo's existing honesty primitive), addedTruePositives (honestly null unless hand-labelled; never fabricated), Jev calls/input tokens/cost/wall-clock from each adapter's usage. bootstrapMeanCi95 (seeded LCG, deterministic) added for repeat-run variance. Results written as both JSON and markdown by run.ts/report.ts. 12 passing metrics tests. Scope note documented in README.md: precision/recall against the AC1 dataset's file/region-labelled findings applies naturally to a finding-generating component (review-jev-rules, flow 330, not yet available); ci-triage/review-conform use domain-appropriate ground truth instead (see README AC3 section).

AC4.note: report.ts formatRate() is the only place a rate is rendered and it never prints a bare percentage (always n + 95% Wilson CI); n<10 rows are labelled **anecdotal** inline; --repeat N (live only) reruns the with-jev arm and reports mean/stddev/bootstrap 95% CI in its own report section. Revert-checked: disabling formatRate's null/CI handling made report.test.ts fail red (a null rate rendered as a bare 0.0%), confirming the guard is load-bearing; reverted after. Live run measured real variance: ci-triage with-jev accuracy 37.5% then 50.0% across 2 repeats (mean 43.8%, stddev 6.3%), reported in bench/jev-review/results-2026-09-25.md.

AC5.note: Offline (default) replays committed fixtures under src/commands/fixtures/ci-triage-eval/ and src/commands/fixtures/conform/ via each verb's existing --fixtures/--eval mechanism; hermetic, no network, verified by tests that strip/poison OPENROUTER_API_KEY and still succeed (adapters/ci-triage.test.ts, adapters/review-conform.test.ts). --live calls the real gh+Jev endpoint for ci-triage (review-conform has no --live flag in the existing CLI, documented, not fabricated). --max-cost (default /usr/bin/zsh.10 documented in cost-cap.ts/README) plus a 300-call cap: offline replay of a component is run first as a cost estimate and a live run whose estimate already implies breaking the cap is refused before any live call (assertEstimateWithinCap); real spend crossing the cap mid-run discards that run's results (CostCapTracker). Revert-checked: disabling the cap's throw made cost-cap.test.ts fail red; reverted after.

AC6.note: Live run: env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY bun bench/jev-review/run.ts --live --repeat 2 (real gh+Jev calls, saved key from ~/.local/share/keryx/auth.json resolved via the existing envWithSavedApiKeys fallback). Committed bench/jev-review/results-2026-09-25.json and .md, plus docs/report/jev-review-benchmark-2026-09-25/results.md (numbers only from that JSON). Total spend: 34 Jev calls, $0.001695 (cap: $0.10/300 calls). No key ever printed (adapters never log the credential; only redacted error paths exist in jev-client.ts, unchanged). Temporary review.jev.ci_triage:true was added to this repo's own .metaproject/tasks.config.json for the live call (documented in README.md and this flow's journal) and removed immediately after; git status --porcelain confirmed no trace left.

AC7.note: 44 tests across 8 files in bench/jev-review/ (build-dataset, metrics, cost-cap, adapters/ci-triage, adapters/review-conform, adapters/registry, report, run) covering: dataset builder on fixture flows (temp dirs via mkdtemp, incl. a real throwaway git repo for the report-closed-by disposition source), metric computations (accuracy/precision/noise/anecdotal/variance), adapter registry (5 adapters, not-available stubs), offline replay (hermetic — tests explicitly poison/strip OPENROUTER_API_KEY and still pass). All pass via bun test, no OS-specific paths/commands (bun/node fs APIs only) — macOS-safe. Revert-checked labelFor (build-dataset.test.ts), CostCapTracker.record (cost-cap.test.ts), and formatRate (report.test.ts): each broke red when disabled, then was restored to green.

AC8.note: No CLI verb added (script under bench/jev-review/, per AC2's explicit alternative), so HELP_GROUPS/commands-by-task/cli.test.ts AC5 allow-list are untouched by design. Docs: bench/jev-review/README.md (full usage, AC-by-AC evidence) and docs/report/jev-review-benchmark-2026-09-25/results.md (numbers-only summary for the article). CI green: typecheck clean, lint clean, check:doc-links 0 broken (1626 links/512 files), keryx flow check clean, keryx health run PASS (score 94). test:core: 11877 pass/4 fail/1 error — all 4 failures/1 error in src/lib/safe-exec.hostile-cwd.e2e.test.ts and src/lib/serve-listener/serve-turns (socket EEXIST + 30s timeouts), unrelated to bench/ (pre-existing, consistent with concurrent sibling-worktree test:core runs observed during this run; not touched by this flow). Import zones respected: bench/ is outside src/, added to tsconfig.json/eslint.config.mjs include lists alongside scripts/ (same ratchet reasoning already documented there).
